#ifndef ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_
#define ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/__assert.h>
#include <math.h> /* For fabs() */
#include <string.h> /* For memcmp() */

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Helper macro for assertions.
 *
 * This macro is used internally by other zassert_* macros.
 * It ensures that the assertion logic is wrapped in a do-while(0) block
 * to behave like a single statement.
 */
#define Z_ASSERT_MSG(cond, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        if (!(cond)) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is true.
 *
 * @param cond Condition to check.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_true(cond, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG(cond, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is false.
 *
 * @param cond Condition to check.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_false(cond, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG(!(cond), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is NULL.
 *
 * @param ptr Pointer to check.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_is_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((ptr) == NULL, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is not NULL.
 *
 * @param ptr Pointer to check.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((ptr) != NULL, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal.
 *
 * @param a First value.
 * @param b Second value.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((a) == (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal.
 *
 * @param a First value.
 * @param b Second value.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((a) != (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is within a specified range.
 *
 * @param val Value to check.
 * @param min Minimum value (inclusive).
 * @param max Maximum value (inclusive).
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_within(val, min, max, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG(((val) >= (min)) && ((val) <= (max)), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is not within a specified range.
 *
 * @param val Value to check.
 * @param min Minimum value (inclusive).
 * @param max Maximum value (inclusive).
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_within(val, min, max, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG(!(((val) >= (min)) && ((val) <= (max))), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are equal.
 *
 * @param ptr1 Pointer to the first memory block.
 * @param ptr2 Pointer to the second memory block.
 * @param size Size of the memory blocks to compare.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_mem_equal(ptr1, ptr2, size, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        if (memcmp(ptr1, ptr2, size) != 0) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are not equal.
 *
 * @param ptr1 Pointer to the first memory block.
 * @param ptr2 Pointer to the second memory block.
 * @param size Size of the memory blocks to compare.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_mem_not_equal(ptr1, ptr2, size, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        if (memcmp(ptr1, ptr2, size) == 0) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a return code is ZTEST_OK (0).
 *
 * @param rc Return code to check.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_ok(rc, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((rc) == 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a return code is not ZTEST_OK (0).
 *
 * @param rc Return code to check.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_ok(rc, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((rc) != 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two pointer values are equal.
 *
 * @param a First pointer value.
 * @param b Second pointer value.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_ptr(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((a) == (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two pointer values are not equal.
 *
 * @param a First pointer value.
 * @param b Second pointer value.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_ptr(a, b, msg, ...) \
    Z_ASSERT_MSG((a) != (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that an array of pointers is equal to another array of pointers.
 *
 * @param a Pointer to the first array.
 * @param b Pointer to the second array.
 * @param count Number of elements to compare.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_ptr_array(a, b, count, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        bool _fail = false; \
        for (size_t i = 0; i < (count); i++) { \
            if ((a)[i] != (b)[i]) { \
                _fail = true; \
                break; \
            } \
        } \
        if (_fail) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that an array of pointers is not equal to another array of pointers.
 *
 * @param a Pointer to the first array.
 * @param b Pointer to the second array.
 * @param count Number of elements to compare.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_ptr_array(a, b, count, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        bool _fail = false; \
        for (size_t i = 0; i < (count); i++) { \
            if ((a)[i] == (b)[i]) { \
                _fail = true; \
                break; \
            } \
        } \
        if (_fail) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that an array of values is equal to another array of values.
 *
 * @param a Pointer to the first array.
 * @param b Pointer to the second array.
 * @param count Number of elements to compare.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_array(a, b, count, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        bool _fail = false; \
        for (size_t i = 0; i < (count); i++) { \
            if ((a)[i] != (b)[i]) { \
                _fail = true; \
                break; \
            } \
        } \
        if (_fail) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that an array of values is not equal to another array of values.
 *
 * @param a Pointer to the first array.
 * @param b Pointer to the second array.
 * @param count Number of elements to compare.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_array(a, b, count, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        bool _fail = false; \
        for (size_t i = 0; i < (count); i++) { \
            if ((a)[i] == (b)[i]) { \
                _fail = true; \
                break; \
            } \
        } \
        if (_fail) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that this code path should not be reached.
 *
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_unreachable(msg, ...) \
    do { \
        ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two float values are equal within a tolerance.
 *
 * @param a First float value.
 * @param b Second float value.
 * @param tolerance Maximum allowed difference.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_almost_equal(a, b, tolerance, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        if (fabs((double)(a) - (double)(b)) > (double)(tolerance)) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two float values are not equal within a tolerance.
 *
 * @param a First float value.
 * @param b Second float value.
 * @param tolerance Maximum allowed difference.
 * @param msg Message to print on failure.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_almost_equal(a, b, tolerance, msg, ...) \
    do { \
        if (fabs((double)(a) - (double)(b)) <= (double)(tolerance)) { \
            ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
        } \
    } while (0)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_ */
